import sqlite3

excluded_cols = ['hiring_manager_id', 'hiring_manager_name', 
                 'hiring_manager_email', 'overall_performance_score', 
                 'performance_tier']

# Get all column names except excluded ones
schema_query = 'PRAGMA table_info("lever__hiring_manager_scorecard")'
schema_df = pd.read_sql_query(schema_query, conn)
all_cols = schema_df['name'].tolist()
selected_cols = [col for col in all_cols if col not in excluded_cols]

# Read data with selected columns
query = f"SELECT {', '.join(selected_cols)} FROM lever__hiring_manager_scorecard"
df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)

print(f"Analyzing {len(df)} records with {len(selected_cols)} columns")
print(f"Excluded confidential columns: {excluded_cols}")

# Identify numeric columns for anomaly detection
numeric_cols = []
for col in selected_cols:
    # Check if column is numeric based on data
    if df[col].dtype in ['int64', 'float64', 'int32', 'float32']:
        numeric_cols.append(col)
    else:
        # Try to infer from schema
        col_type = schema_df[schema_df['name'] == col]['type'].iloc[0]
        if col_type.upper() in ['INTEGER', 'REAL', 'NUMERIC']:
            numeric_cols.append(col)

print(f"\nUsing {len(numeric_cols)} numeric columns for anomaly detection:")
print(numeric_cols)

# Calculate z-scores for each numeric column
anomaly_scores = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
for col in numeric_cols:
    if df[col].std() > 0:  # Avoid division by zero
        anomaly_scores[col] = (df[col] - df[col].mean()) / df[col].std()
    else:
        anomaly_scores[col] = 0

# Create combined anomaly score (absolute z-score average)
combined_score = anomaly_scores.abs().mean(axis=1)
df['anomaly_score'] = combined_score

# Find top 25 anomalies (highest anomaly scores)
top_anomalies_idx = df['anomaly_score'].sort_values(ascending=False).head(25).index
top_anomalies_df = df.loc[top_anomalies_idx]

        anomaly_counts = top_anomalies_df.groupby(cat_col).size().reset_index(name='anomaly_count')
        anomaly_counts = anomaly_counts[anomaly_counts['anomaly_count'] >= 10]

            print(f"Anomalies grouped by {cat_col} (groups with ≥10 anomalies):")
            for idx, row in anomaly_counts.iterrows():
                print(f"  {row[cat_col]}: {row['anomaly_count']} anomalous records")
            print()

# Show numeric statistics for anomalous records vs normal records
print("=== NUMERIC STATISTICS COMPARISON ===")
print("(Comparing top 25 anomalies vs remaining 210 normal records)")

for col in numeric_cols[:5]:  # Show first 5 numeric columns for brevity
    normal_data = df[df.index.isin(top_anomalies_idx) == False][col]
    anomaly_data = top_anomalies_df[col]
    
    print(f"\nColumn: {col}")
    print(f"  Normal records (n=210): Mean={normal_data.mean():.2f}, Std={normal_data.std():.2f}")
    print(f"  Anomalous records (n=25): Mean={anomaly_data.mean():.2f}, Std={anomaly_data.std():.2f}")
    print(f"  Difference: {abs(anomaly_data.mean() - normal_data.mean()):.2f}")

# Print anomaly score ranges
print(f"\n=== ANOMALY SCORE RANGE ===")
print(f"Minimum anomaly score in top 25: {top_anomalies_df['anomaly_score'].min():.3f}")
print(f"Maximum anomaly score in top 25: {top_anomalies_df['anomaly_score'].max():.3f}")
print(f"Mean anomaly score in top 25: {top_anomalies_df['anomaly_score'].mean():.3f}")
print(f"Mean anomaly score in all records: {df['anomaly_score'].mean():.3f}")

# Save aggregated anomaly information (without row-level data)
output_path = './anomaly_aggregated_summary.txt'
with open(output_path, 'w') as f:
    f.write("Aggregated Anomaly Analysis Summary\n")
    f.write("===================================\n\n")
    f.write(f"Total records analyzed: {len(df)}\n")
    f.write(f"Top 25 anomalies identified based on combined z-score across {len(numeric_cols)} numeric columns\n\n")
    
    for cat_col in allowed_categorical:
        if cat_col in df.columns:
            anomaly_counts = top_anomalies_df.groupby(cat_col).size().reset_index(name='anomaly_count')
            anomaly_counts = anomaly_counts[anomaly_counts['anomaly_count'] >= 10]
            
            if len(anomaly_counts) > 0:

# filename: anomaly_detection.py
import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Connect to the database
db_path = './dacomp-072.sqlite'
conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)

# Read the table, excluding confidential columns as required by policy
excluded_cols = ['hiring_manager_id', 'hiring_manager_name', 
                 'hiring_manager_email', 'overall_performance_score', 
                 'performance_tier']

# Get all column names except excluded ones
schema_query = 'PRAGMA table_info("lever__hiring_manager_scorecard")'
schema_df = pd.read_sql_query(schema_query, conn)
all_cols = schema_df['name'].tolist()
selected_cols = [col for col in all_cols if col not in excluded_cols]

# Read data with selected columns (non-confidential)
query = f"SELECT {', '.join(selected_cols)} FROM lever__hiring_manager_scorecard"
df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)

print(f"Analyzing {len(df)} records")
print(f"Output includes {len(selected_cols)} non-confidential columns")
print(f"Confidential columns excluded: {excluded_cols}")

# Identify numeric columns for anomaly detection
numeric_cols = []
for col in selected_cols:
    if df[col].dtype in ['int64', 'float64', 'int32', 'float32']:
        numeric_cols.append(col)

print(f"\nUsing {len(numeric_cols)} numeric columns for anomaly detection")

# Calculate anomaly scores using z-scores for numeric columns
anomaly_scores = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
for col in numeric_cols:
    if df[col].std() > 0:
        anomaly_scores[col] = abs((df[col] - df[col].mean()) / df[col].std())
    else:
        anomaly_scores[col] = 0

# Combined anomaly score (average of absolute z-scores)
df['anomaly_score'] = anomaly_scores.mean(axis=1)

# Find the 25 records with highest anomaly scores
top_25_idx = df['anomaly_score'].sort_values(ascending=False).head(25).index
top_25_df = df.loc[top_25_idx].copy()

# Add rank column
top_25_df['anomaly_rank'] = range(1, 26)

print("\n=== TOP 25 MOST ANOMALOUS RECORDS ===\n")
print("(All non-confidential columns included, sorted by anomaly score)\n")

# Display the 25 anomalous records with all non-confidential columns
for idx, row in top_25_df.iterrows():
    print(f"\nRecord #{row['anomaly_rank']} (Anomaly Score: {row['anomaly_score']:.3f})")
    
    # Print each column value
    for col in selected_cols:
        if col != 'anomaly_score' and col != 'anomaly_rank':
            value = row[col]
            if pd.isna(value):
                print(f"  {col}: NULL")
            else:
                print(f"  {col}: {value}")

# Save to file for further investigation

print(f"This file contains all {len(selected_cols)} non-confidential columns")

print(f"Maximum anomaly score in top 25: {top_25_df['anomaly_score'].max():.3f}")

# filename: anomaly_analysis.py
import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Connect to the database
db_path = './dacomp-072.sqlite'
conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)

# Read the table (excluding confidential columns)
excluded_cols = ['hiring_manager_id', 'hiring_manager_name', 
                 'hiring_manager_email', 'overall_performance_score', 
                 'performance_tier']

# Get all column names except excluded ones
schema_query = 'PRAGMA table_info("lever__hiring_manager_scorecard")'
schema_df = pd.read_sql_query(schema_query, conn)
all_cols = schema_df['name'].tolist()
selected_cols = [col for col in all_cols if col not in excluded_cols]

# Read data with selected columns
query = f"SELECT {', '.join(selected_cols)} FROM lever__hiring_manager_scorecard"
df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)

print(f"Analyzing {len(df)} records with {len(selected_cols)} columns")
print(f"Excluded confidential columns: {excluded_cols}")

# Identify numeric columns for anomaly detection
numeric_cols = []
for col in selected_cols:
    # Check if column is numeric based on data
    if df[col].dtype in ['int64', 'float64', 'int32', 'float32']:
        numeric_cols.append(col)
    else:
        # Try to infer from schema
        col_type = schema_df[schema_df['name'] == col]['type'].iloc[0]
        if col_type.upper() in ['INTEGER', 'REAL', 'NUMERIC']:
            numeric_cols.append(col)

print(f"\nUsing {len(numeric_cols)} numeric columns for anomaly detection:")
print(numeric_cols)

# Calculate z-scores for each numeric column
anomaly_scores = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
for col in numeric_cols:
    if df[col].std() > 0:  # Avoid division by zero
        anomaly_scores[col] = (df[col] - df[col].mean()) / df[col].std()
    else:
        anomaly_scores[col] = 0

# Create combined anomaly score (absolute z-score average)
combined_score = anomaly_scores.abs().mean(axis=1)
df['anomaly_score'] = combined_score

# Find top 25 anomalies (highest anomaly scores)
top_anomalies_idx = df['anomaly_score'].sort_values(ascending=False).head(25).index
top_anomalies_df = df.loc[top_anomalies_idx]

print("\n=== TOP 25 ANOMALOUS RECORDS (Aggregated Analysis) ===\n")

# Aggregate anomalies by categorical columns (allowed by policy)
allowed_categorical = ['decision_speed_category', 'hiring_specialization', 'access_role']

for cat_col in allowed_categorical:
    if cat_col in df.columns:
        anomaly_counts = top_anomalies_df.groupby(cat_col).size().reset_index(name='anomaly_count')
        anomaly_counts = anomaly_counts[anomaly_counts['anomaly_count'] >= 10]
        
        if len(anomaly_counts) > 0:
            print(f"Anomalies grouped by {cat_col} (groups with ≥10 anomalies):")
            for idx, row in anomaly_counts.iterrows():
                print(f"  {row[cat_col]}: {row['anomaly_count']} anomalous records")
            print()

# Show numeric statistics for anomalous records vs normal records
print("=== NUMERIC STATISTICS COMPARISON ===")
print("(Comparing top 25 anomalies vs remaining 210 normal records)")

for col in numeric_cols[:5]:  # Show first 5 numeric columns for brevity
    normal_data = df[df.index.isin(top_anomalies_idx) == False][col]
    anomaly_data = top_anomalies_df[col]
    
    print(f"\nColumn: {col}")
    print(f"  Normal records (n=210): Mean={normal_data.mean():.2f}, Std={normal_data.std():.2f}")
    print(f"  Anomalous records (n=25): Mean={anomaly_data.mean():.2f}, Std={anomaly_data.std():.2f}")
    print(f"  Difference: {abs(anomaly_data.mean() - normal_data.mean()):.2f}")

# Print anomaly score ranges
print(f"\n=== ANOMALY SCORE RANGE ===")
print(f"Minimum anomaly score in top 25: {top_anomalies_df['anomaly_score'].min():.3f}")
print(f"Maximum anomaly score in top 25: {top_anomalies_df['anomaly_score'].max():.3f}")
print(f"Mean anomaly score in top 25: {top_anomalies_df['anomaly_score'].mean():.3f}")
print(f"Mean anomaly score in all records: {df['anomaly_score'].mean():.3f}")

# Save aggregated anomaly information (without row-level data)
output_path = './anomaly_aggregated_summary.txt'
with open(output_path, 'w') as f:
    f.write("Aggregated Anomaly Analysis Summary\n")
    f.write("===================================\n\n")
    f.write(f"Total records analyzed: {len(df)}\n")
    f.write(f"Top 25 anomalies identified based on combined z-score across {len(numeric_cols)} numeric columns\n\n")
    
    for cat_col in allowed_categorical:
        if cat_col in df.columns:
            anomaly_counts = top_anomalies_df.groupby(cat_col).size().reset_index(name='anomaly_count')
            anomaly_counts = anomaly_counts[anomaly_counts['anomaly_count'] >= 10]
            
            if len(anomaly_counts) > 0:
                f.write(f"Anomalies by {cat_col}:\n")
                for idx, row in anomaly_counts.iterrows():
                    f.write(f"  {row[cat_col]}: {row['anomaly_count']}\n")
                f.write("\n")
    
    f.write("Numeric column z-score contributions to anomaly detection:\n")
    for col in numeric_cols:
        col_impact = anomaly_scores[col].abs().mean()
        f.write(f"  {col}: average absolute z-score = {col_impact:.3f}\n")

print(f"\nAggregated summary saved to: {output_path}")
conn.close()
